task:
Open the file /home/user/Documents/meeting_notes.odt in LibreOffice Writer. It contains raw unformatted meeting minutes with all paragraphs in Default Paragraph Style.

Perform the following formatting and editing tasks:

1. Set the first paragraph 'Project Alpha Meeting Minutes' to Heading 1 style and make it bold.
2. Find the paragraphs that contain exactly the text 'Attendees', 'Agenda', 'Discussion', and 'Action Items' and set each of them to Heading 2 style.
3. Use Find & Replace (Ctrl+H) to replace ALL occurrences of 'TBD' with 'To Be Determined'. There are 5 occurrences in the document.
4. Add a page header with the text 'Project Alpha - Confidential' (via Format > Page Style > Header tab, enable header, then type the text).
5. Add a page footer with the text 'Page' (via Format > Page Style > Footer tab, enable footer, then type the text).
6. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
